blocks.goal: Extract the prefix-based acceptance and rejection implementation from AcceptReject so that its cohesive state and behavior are maintained in a separate class.

ops.details: Extract the AcceptRejectPrefix subclass, including its addToAccept, addToReject, isAcceptedAndNotRejected, isAccepted, acceptHasPrefix, and isRejected methods and the protected state they require. Keep it in the same package and preserve its inheritance from AcceptReject.
Update references to the nested AcceptRejectPrefix class to use the extracted class while preserving constructor arguments and behavior.

blocks.goal: Extract the whole-string acceptance and rejection implementation from AcceptReject to reduce the size of the target class and isolate its specialized state and algorithms.

ops.details: Extract the AcceptRejectWholeString subclass, including addToAccept, wildcardIndex, addToReject, isAcceptedAndNotRejected, isAccepted, acceptHasPrefix, and isRejected, together with the protected fields used by those methods. Keep it in the same package and preserve its inheritance from AcceptReject.
Update references to the nested AcceptRejectWholeString class to use the extracted class while preserving constructor arguments and behavior.

blocks.goal: Extract the leaf-name-specific adaptation from AcceptReject so that path-to-leaf-name conversion is isolated from the core acceptance and rejection implementation.

ops.details: Extract the AcceptRejectLeafname subclass, including its overridden addToAccept, addToReject, isAcceptedAndNotRejected, isAccepted, acceptHasPrefix, and isRejected methods. Preserve its inheritance from AcceptRejectWholeString and its use of JarUtils.leafName.
Update references to the nested AcceptRejectLeafname class to use the extracted class while preserving constructor arguments and behavior.
